title: Overlay safe soundboard response (PRF-02 slice 7, catalogue module #6)
description: The overlay-facing projection of a channel's single most recent creator-triggered soundboard play, scoped by the overlay session token. The module name describes the PLAYBACK being safe for a broadcast, never the CONTENT being vetted -- no field here, and no field anywhere in this schema, may claim a clip is safe, approved, checked, reviewed, vetted or curated. Seven fields and nothing else: no viewer, supporter or session identifier exists on this path, and none exists in the schema behind it either -- playId is an opaque event id for client-side de-duplication only, never an identity. playbackUrl is resolved by the API from a content-addressed GCS object key against the server's OWN configured CDN base (19.1), never a caller- or database-supplied URL, and is null whenever that base is not configured -- which is every environment today. Duration and file-size upload caps are likewise configured but unset: the upload path they gate is inert until a value exists, never treated as unlimited. This returns the single most recent trigger, not a never-drop queue, and no cooldown is applied -- none is decided anywhere in this repository. A null soundboardPlay is what an unrecognised, expired, revoked or foreign overlay token returns, what a channel that has triggered nothing returns, and what a channel without the 30.3 Pro+ entitlement returns -- all of them mean paint nothing.
